Cory (arch): Noticed a subtle bug: affinity cache is storing raw control-plane tokens when fallback routes to dedicated/private. Risky.
Yuki (eng-runtime): can you share the repro?
Cory (arch): steps: pin model on hosted, simulate zone flake, request falls back -> dedicated adapter binds token and we see same token reused across different requests in same worker.
Asha (eng-platform): That matches a report from infra earlier. We built affinity to speed routing but conflated routing keys with credential binding.
Ben (sec): immediate constraint: never persist raw CP/tenant tokens outside KMS boundary. Affinity must be a routing hint only.
Mina (product): customers flagged billing attribution noise; no data leak yet but this is critical for trust.
Yuki (eng-runtime): implementation plan: change affinity cache value to an opaque handle id (h-...) instead of token. Worker resolves handle to per-request short token via exchange client.
Asha (eng-platform): we'll back it with a lease service so handles expire and are re-fetched on restart. If unresolved, worker should fail-closed.
Ben (sec): require audit events: handle.requested, handle.resolved, handle.rejected with proof id and origin. Add metrics: handle_exchange_rate and handle_resolve_fail_rate.
Cory (arch): private deployments: we can't exchange centrally if customer manages KMS. Contract: adapter must expose /v1/exchange-handle to turn handle->token. Document during onboarding.
Yuki (eng-runtime): perf worry: extra hop per-request. Mitigations: aggressive TTLs, micro-cache keyed by request fingerprint, and fast-path when CP and dedicated share trust. We'll gate behind runtime.credential_exchange_v2 flag.
infra-bot: created milestone credential-exchange-v2 (owner: yuki).
Mina (product): timeline: docs + onboarding checklist in two sprints. Notify existing private customers to opt-in.
Cory (arch): I'll add this to the architecture RFC with sequence diagram and threat-model notes. Keep affinity purely routing; never transport raw tokens.
Yuki (eng-runtime): ack. I'll open the spike PR and perf tests.
